title: Infinite-dimensional Dyson Brownian motion(s)
summary: We study infinite-dimensional Dyson Brownian motions obtained as limits of finite systems without rescaling the actual stochastic dynamics. For $β=2$, we construct determinantal processes on an extended space of initial data and prove convergence of their finite-dimensional distributions under essentially optimal conditions. This extends the seminal results of Katori and Tanemura. The additional parameters record information at infinity and enter through an associated Laguerre-Pólya entire function.
